title: Lisbon, the breakfast table
logline: The invented hotel's breakfast table by a window: a coffee, a roll, a napkin, one chair pushed in and one pulled out. The card said nothing about breakfast. He gives her one.

panels.composition: A small hotel breakfast table by a shuttered window with a coffee, a roll on a plate and a folded napkin, one chair pushed in and one pulled out, bright light.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small hotel breakfast table by a shuttered window with a coffee, a roll on a plate and a folded napkin, one chair pushed in and one pulled out, bright light, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The card said nothing about breakfast.
